## Checklist

- [ ] The branch name picks the release: `feature/…` for a minor version, anything else for a patch.
- [ ] `make test` and `make lint` pass.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry under `Unreleased`.
- [ ] The docs (README or `docs/`) describe any change in behaviour.
- [ ] Commands, flags and MCP tools are only added, never renamed or removed, and the board format only gains optional fields ([docs/FORMAT.md](../docs/FORMAT.md)).
- [ ] No secrets or private data in code, tests or examples.
